title: ESM information request completion by the network

entities.name: ESM INFORMATION RESPONSE
entities.description: Message sent by the UE containing ESM information requested by the network.

entities.name: T3489
entities.description: Timer used by the network during ESM information request procedure.

entities.name: PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE
entities.description: State entered by the network after completing the ESM information request procedure.

entities.name: Protocol configuration options IE
entities.description: Information element containing protocol configuration options.

entities.name: Extended protocol configuration options IE
entities.description: Information element containing extended protocol configuration options.

entities.name: IE replacement condition
entities.description: Condition where protocol configuration options IE or extended protocol configuration options IE in ESM INFORMATION RESPONSE message replaces previously received IEs.

relations.description: Receipt of ESM INFORMATION RESPONSE message stops timer T3489.
Receipt of ESM INFORMATION RESPONSE message causes network to enter PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE state.
ESM INFORMATION RESPONSE message may contain protocol configuration options IE.
ESM INFORMATION RESPONSE message may contain extended protocol configuration options IE.
IE replacement condition governs the behavior of protocol configuration options IE.
IE replacement condition governs the behavior of extended protocol configuration options IE.
